_doc: Flaw & Perk system. Each 'mishap' kind counts repeated failures. At 'threshold' the game OFFERS the linked flaw: accept it -> permanent downside + free skill points. Declining raises the next threshold. Perks are bought with skill points. mods: add = flat bonus, mul = percent (0.2 = +20%).

parry_hesitation.name: Parry Hesitation
parry_hesitation.desc: You flinch a hair too long before every parry.

jittery_trigger.name: Jittery Trigger Finger
jittery_trigger.desc: Your trigger finger has trust issues. Accuracy -8%.

bug_magnet.name: Bug Magnet
bug_magnet.desc: Insects find you delicious. Bug bites hurt more.

shell_shock.name: Shell Shock
shell_shock.desc: Explosions rattle you. Dodge roll recovers 15% slower.

subscription_lungs.name: Subscription Lungs
subscription_lungs.desc: Your lungs got used to premium air. Breathing costs 25% more.

wanted_face.name: Memorable Face
wanted_face.desc: Everyone recognises you now. Witnesses report 25% faster.

paranoid_spine.name: Paranoid Spine
paranoid_spine.desc: You keep checking behind you. Move speed -5%.

paste_intolerance.name: Paste Intolerance
paste_intolerance.desc: Protein Paste(tm) and you are no longer on speaking terms. Max HP -10.

ghost_jitters.name: Ghost Jitters
ghost_jitters.desc: Derelicts make your hands shake. Fire rate -10%.

spam_brain.name: Spam Brain
spam_brain.desc: Forty newsletters live in your head now. Shop prices +5% (you keep impulse-buying extended warranties).

silver_tongue.name: Silver Tongue
silver_tongue.desc: Bribes cost 30% less and work more often.

ghost_step.name: Ghost Step
ghost_step.desc: Witnesses take 40% longer to finish their radio call.

parry_maestro.name: Parry Maestro
parry_maestro.desc: Parry window +0.06s. Parried enemies stay staggered longer.

demolitionist.name: Demolitionist
demolitionist.desc: Jetpack and tank explosions deal +50% damage (and you take 50% less from them).
